findings.current: Somehow, I should have saved it and learned the true identity of the people behind it.
findings.defect: The source leaves the number and identity of whoever was behind the Kraken unresolved, while “the people” explicitly establishes multiple perpetrators.
findings.rationale: 배후 is number-neutral here, and the responsible party remains an unresolved mystery.
findings.replacement: Somehow, I should have kept it alive and learned the true identity of whoever was behind it.
findings.source: 어떻게든 살려서 배후의 진짜 정체를 알아냈어야 했다.

findings.current: Hundreds of casualties had already occurred before I could even arrive, but there were still more survivors waiting to be rescued.
findings.defect: “Still more survivors” can mean merely additional survivors and loses the source’s explicit quantitative comparison: those awaiting rescue outnumber the hundreds of casualties.
findings.rationale: 숫자가 더 많다 explicitly states that the number of survivors is greater.
findings.replacement: Hundreds of casualties had already occurred before I could even arrive, but the survivors still waiting to be rescued outnumbered them.
findings.source: 내가 미처 도착하기도 전에 수백의 사상자가 발생했지만, 아직 구조를 기다리는 생존자들의 숫자가 더 많다.

findings.current: You have defeated [Lv. 140 ‘King of the Black Sea’ Kraken]!
findings.defect: The entity remains enclosed in square brackets inside a System window, contrary to the binding System-panel format.
findings.rationale: The framed System block already identifies the UI context, and the rules explicitly prohibit retaining these square brackets.
findings.replacement: You have defeated Lv. 140 ‘King of the Black Sea’ Kraken!

findings.current: Choi Minwoo, Cheon Taemin’s grandson and only living blood relative.
findings.defect: The translation drops the explicitly maternal side of the grandparent relationship.
findings.rationale: 외손자 specifically means a daughter’s son, not merely a grandson.
findings.replacement: Choi Minwoo, Cheon Taemin’s maternal grandson and only living blood relative.

findings.current: *The dinner he said he’d make tonight was… kimchi stew, wasn’t it?*
findings.defect: The masculine pronoun assigns the promised cooking to a man, although the established subject is Jin Taekyung’s mother.
findings.rationale: The thought continues directly from the discussion of Jin Taekyung’s mother preparing Choi Minwoo’s meals, and the honorific verb refers to her.
findings.replacement: *The dinner she said she’d make tonight was… kimchi stew, wasn’t it?*
findings.source: ‘오늘 해 주시겠다고 한 저녁 메뉴가 아마…… 김치찌개였나.’

findings.current: Team Leader Choi already knew who was calling and answered immediately.
findings.defect: The source says Choi had guessed the caller, not that he knew with certainty; that distinction sets up his mistaken greeting and the reveal of a different caller.
findings.rationale: 짐작 means conjecture or inference, and the following exchange proves that his assumption was wrong.
findings.replacement: Having already guessed who was calling, Team Leader Choi answered immediately.
findings.source: 이미 발신인을 짐작하고 있던 최 팀장이 곧장 전화를 받았다.

findings.current: An old voice rang out from the other end of the phone.
findings.defect: The translation omits the explicit identification of the caller as Song Cheonwoo.
findings.rationale: The source names Song Cheonwoo at the reveal; reducing him to an unidentified old voice withholds a scene fact from the reader.
findings.replacement: Song Cheonwoo’s aged voice rang out from the other end of the phone.
findings.source: 수화기 너머, 송천우의 늙수그레한 목소리가 울려 퍼졌다.

summary: Several fidelity defects alter an actor, omit a named speaker, narrow unresolved culpability, and lose explicit kinship and quantity details; one System line also violates the required formatting.
